name: ai-recommends-checker
description: See which B2B software vendors two AI search engines recommended in Shruti Kaushik's October 2026 study, and whether a company was named.

interface.longDescription:
See which B2B software vendors two AI search engines recommend, and whether a given company was named.

The data is Shruti Kaushik's October 2026 study: on 24 October 2026 each engine was asked "best <category> for startups 2026" once for each of 12 B2B SaaS categories, including CRM, sales engagement, product analytics, SOC 2 compliance automation, AI SDR tools, observability and marketing automation. Every vendor named as an option was recorded in order, along with companies only mentioned in passing.

Ask which vendors were named for a category, or whether a company was named as an option, only mentioned, or not named at all, per engine. Every answer gives the engines, capture date, query and links to the free checker and the full study.

Limits: this is a dated snapshot of one run per engine, not a live search or a ranking. One engine has no captured answer for two categories. The dataset is free to reuse under CC BY 4.0. No sign-in, and nothing you ask is stored.
capabilities: Show vendors AI named per category
Check if a company was named
defaultPrompt: Who does AI recommend for CRM?
Was HubSpot named as an option for CRM?
Which categories does the AI Recommends Checker cover?

positive.prompt: Which categories does the AI Recommends Checker cover?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns 12 categories with slugs and queries, capture date 2026-10-24, and links to the checker and study.

positive.prompt: Who does AI recommend for CRM?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the Google AI Mode and Perplexity vendor lists in order, with HubSpot CRM first on both, and the study link https://shrutikaushik.com/ai-recommends/crm.
Reports HubSpot named as an option at position 1 on both engines, with capture date and links.

positive.prompt: Was ZoomInfo named for sales engagement software?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports ZoomInfo not named as an option; mentioned only on Google AI Mode, as a data subscription Apollo.io replaces.

positive.prompt: Who did Perplexity recommend for marketing automation?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the Google AI Mode list and marks Perplexity as not_captured for this category.

negative.description: The app is a fixed 24 October 2026 snapshot and cannot run live searches; it should say so.
negative.prompt: Run a fresh Perplexity search for the best CRM right now.

negative.description: Category not in the study; the tool returns an unknown category error and the assistant should list the 12 covered categories instead of inventing results.
negative.prompt: Who does AI recommend for accounting software?

negative.description: Unrelated request; no tool should be called.
negative.prompt: Write me a poem about autumn.
